name: Chair-supported march

instructions.en: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair and march one knee at a time at a comfortable pace.
instructions.tr: Sabit bir sandalyenin on tarafina dik oturun ve dizlerinizi rahat bir tempoda sirayla kaldirin.

en: Sit tall near the front of a stable chair.
Place both feet flat on the floor.
Lift one knee slightly, lower it, then repeat on the other side.
tr: Sabit bir sandalyenin on tarafina dik oturun.
Iki ayaginizi da yere duz basin.
Bir dizinizi hafifce kaldirin, indirin ve diger tarafla tekrarlayin.

attribution: MoveInRange CI fixture; no external media included.

name: Wall shoulder glide

instructions.en: Stand near a wall and slide the hands upward only within a comfortable, pain-free range.
instructions.tr: Duvara yakin durun ve ellerinizi yalnizca rahat, agrisiz aralikta yukari kaydirin.

en: Stand facing a wall with relaxed shoulders.
Place fingertips on the wall at chest height.
Slide the hands upward only as far as comfortable, then return.
tr: Omuzlar rahat olacak sekilde duvara donuk durun.
Parmak uclarinizi gogus hizasinda duvara yerlestirin.
Ellerinizi rahat oldugu kadar yukari kaydirin ve geri donun.

attribution: MoveInRange CI fixture; no external media included.
